_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Pod Structural Design Criteria Report
summary: Describes the complete set of criteria used to design a pod structure, used to verify the pod structure meets all operational and maintenance requirements defined in the contract.
use_relationship:
The Pod Structural Design Criteria Report describes the complete set of criteria used to design a pod structure. The data will be used to verify that the pod structure will meet all operational and maintenance requirements defined in the contract.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content for data resulting from the work tasks described by the contract statement of work.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-82265.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content:
The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

(Copies of the Joint Service Specification Guide (JSSG)-2006 (Aircraft Structures) are available online at https://assist.dla.mil/)

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Pod Structural Design Criteria report shall contain the following:

children.title: Relevant and tailored structural design criteria from the JSSG-2006
children.content: Describe the relevant and tailored structural design criteria from the JSSG-2006 that are to be used to design the pod structure.

children.title: Additional relevant and tailored structural design criteria
children.content: Describe any additional relevant and tailored structural design criteria that are to be used to design the pod structure.

children.title: Proposed structural design criteria that differs from common and accepted aerospace industry design criteria
children.content: Describe any proposed structural design criteria that differs from common and accepted aerospace industry design criteria for Naval Tactical Aircraft structural design.

children.title: Verification methodology to be used in conjunction with the structural design criteria
children.content: Describe the verification methodology to be used in conjunction with the structural design criteria to show that the pod structure will meet the requirements in the contract.
